title: Business information
description: Your store name, address, and contact number.
intro: This is what prints on your receipts and shows on your reports.
steps: Click Sidebar > Settings, then Business Details.
Type your business name, TIN, address, and contact number.
Turn on VAT or BIR only if your store is registered for them.
Click Save. That clicks this step off your checklist.

title: Business hours
description: What time your store opens and closes.
intro: The POS uses these to know when a business day starts and ends.
steps: Click Sidebar > Settings, then General.
Scroll to Operating hours.
Set your opening and closing time. Tick the days you are open.
Click Save. Reports and the Z reading follow these hours.

title: Add products
description: Put in the items you sell.
intro: Everything you sell lives on this page.
steps: Click Sidebar > Products, then Product List.
Click Add Product. Type the name, barcode, cost, and price. Pick a category. Click Save.
Have many items? Click Manage, then Bulk Manage to type them in a spreadsheet.
Have a list already? Click Import Products to bring in an Excel or CSV file.

title: Add inventory count
description: Count how many of each item you have.
intro: Tell the POS how many of each product you have on hand.
steps: Click Sidebar > Inventory, then Inventory Count.
Click New Inventory Count.
Click each product on the left to add it. Or scan its barcode.
Type the counted quantity on the right.
Click Save. Stock is corrected to match your numbers.

locked.intro: Inventory count is a Pro feature, so this page is locked on your current plan.
steps: Start your free trial, or upgrade your plan, from the panel on this page.
Once Inventory unlocks, click New Inventory Count. Add the products you are counting.
Type the counted quantity for each one. Click Save.

title: Payment methods
description: Cash, GCash, and Maya are ready. Add cards or bank transfer if you take them.
intro: Cash, GCash, Maya, and QRPH are already set up for you.
steps: Click Sidebar > Payment Methods.
Click Add Payment Method for card, bank transfer, or anything else you accept.
Type a name and pick its payment type. Click Save.
Use the switches to turn a method off instead of deleting it.

title: Receipt format
description: Put your logo on the receipt and pick a look.
intro: Make the receipt look like your store.
steps: Click Sidebar > Settings, then Receipts & Reports.
Upload your logo. Choose where it sits on the receipt.
Pick a layout and check the preview.
Click Save. Your next sale prints with the new look.

title: Add your team
description: Create login accounts for your staff.
intro: Each cashier and manager should have their own login.
steps: Open Sidebar > Users & Security.
Click Add User and enter their name and login details.
Choose a role so each person can only access what they need.
Go to the Branches tab and select where they work. Click Save.

title: Set up printer
description: Have a receipt printer? Set it up on the cashier. No printer? Skip this.
intro: Printer Setup lives on the cashier, since the printer sits at the register. No printer? Skip this step on the checklist.
steps: Click Point of Sale in the sidebar. The register opens.
Click More Options, then Printer Setup.
Register this terminal if asked. Pick the paper width, 58mm or 80mm.
Click Test Print to check the cut and the margins. Click Save Settings.

title: Add your first supplier
intro: Suppliers are who you buy stock from. Purchase orders and receiving start here.
steps: Click Suppliers in the sidebar.
Click Add Suppliers. Type the name and contact details.
Click Save. The supplier can then be picked on a purchase order.
Later, click the arrow on a supplier row to see its purchase orders and products.

title: Record your first expense
description: Rent, utilities, wages, and other spending.
intro: Expenses are what the store spends outside stock, like rent, utilities, and wages.
steps: Click Expenses in the sidebar.
Click Add Expense. Pick a type, or add a new type if none fits.
Type the amount, the date, and a short note. Click Save.
The totals at the top and the dashboard update right away.

title: Make your first sale
description: Sell anything on the cashier and you are done.
intro: This is the screen your staff will use every day.
steps: Click Point of Sale in the sidebar. The register opens.
Scan a barcode, or search a product, to add it to the cart.
Click Record Payment. Pick a payment method and type the amount tendered.
Confirm. The receipt prints and your setup checklist is complete.
